{{Quote|Awright, lads. The're past! An' here come the bloodhounds!|A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] describes [[Shrike Squadron (Mandalore)|Shrike Squadron]]|<ref name="SW69">[[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]]</ref>}}
'''Bloodhounds''' were creatures which were known to pursue their prey with much ferocity. During the [[Battle of the City of Bone]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who were revolting referred to [[Shrike Squadron (Mandalore)|Shrike Squadron]] as "bloodhounds" in an effort to describe their tenacity.<ref name="SW69" /> [[Customs Inspector]]s were also likened to bloodhounds by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] due to their ability to find contraband.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
